task: S side of H05 R2: Status::Quarantined -24 pass-through in services/volume and its clients, plus revision 1 of the post-wake remount design (R1/R2 answers and four review points)
summary: 43/100, unchanged: the volume service now passes the kernel lane quarantine through as Status::Quarantined -24 on its certain-abort device paths instead of reporting Protocol -15; document-session closes on it, destination maps it to NoDevice and native-volume to Io, with host tests in services/volume/tests/quarantine.rs. VOLUME-POST-WAKE-REMOUNT.md revision 1 records H's R1/R2 proposals (grant only to the same instance; RemountRefused as a separate service status, value fixed in the ADR amendment) and fixes the closed-storage wording, the empty-volume reference and the chunk-cache invalidation. RemountRefused, the remount code, a native wake case and physical S3 do not exist; S09 and H05 stay open.
